content.rendered: Are your bookshelves due for a cleanup?  Laurel Ridge is partnering with Hopkins Elementary in their book drive.  Every year, Hopkins has a book trade-in event where students can bring books they’ve grown out of and trade them for more challenging books.  To offer even more choices to their students,  Laurel Ridge is accepting all book donations from 5/2-5/9 to pass on to the readers at Hopkins.  Donation boxes will be in the office, as well as in some Language Arts classrooms.  Please send any questions to bpatterson@sherwood.k12.or.us
